author: Igor Patrick
description:
A campaign document belonging to Flavio Bolsonaro, the right-wing front-runner in the presidential election to be held in Brazil next month, offered Washington a rare earths supply chain designed to weaken China’s grip, local news site Amado Mundo reported on Saturday.
Written in English and dated March 19, the 22-page presentation was drafted by Andre Marinho, a close Bolsonaro ally who presented the plan to the Rockbridge Network, a group of wealthy conservative donors founded by J.D. Vance in...
title: J.D. Vance group courted Brazil’s Flavio Bolsonaro over anti-China rare earth deal: report

author: Gabriel Dominguez
description:
The People’s Liberation Army may be seeking to give its frontline mechanised units mobile protection against the kind of drone-saturated battlefield that could emerge in a Taiwan conflict.
Unverified images posted on mainland Chinese social media on August 29 show a new variant of the Type 19 amphibious 8x8 combat vehicle featuring a turret-mounted laser weapon and extra sensors alongside its standard autocannon.
Janes, an open-source defence intelligence provider, reported in 2023 that vehicles...
title: Why PLA’s laser-equipped Type 19 vehicle could matter in a Taiwan conflict

author: Alyssa Chen
description:
Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian and Crown Prince Sheikh Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan of Abu Dhabi met on the sidelines of the Brics summit in New Delhi on Saturday, marking the highest-level meeting between the two sides since the Iran war began.
The bilateral meeting came as the fallout of the war in Iran widened, with Saudi Arabia shutting its key East-West oil pipeline after it was attacked by drones on Friday. The closure of the pipeline stretching across the Arabian peninsula...
title: Iranian president, Abu Dhabi crown prince meet on sidelines of Brics summit in India

author: Khushboo Razdan
description:
Brics countries agreed on Saturday to expand trade and payments in local currencies, making another step towards de-dollarisation as the bloc seeks to counter an assertive United States.
Facing pressure from Washington, the member nations found enough common ground to overcome some of their biggest diplomatic splits.
The pledges were part of the “New Delhi Declaration 2026”, adopted unanimously on the opening day of the 18th Brics summit.
After a closed session, Indian Prime Minister Narendra...
title: Under Trump’s shadow, Brics takes step towards de-dollarisation

author: Khushboo Razdan,Orange Wang
description:
Chinese President Xi Jinping told Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Saturday that China and India, as the world’s most populous nations and key members of the Global South, bore “significant responsibilities” in an international landscape “fraught with turbulence and change”.
That message framed why the two sides should work together despite their differences. Xi said that although the countries had different national circumstances, “there is ample scope for us to learn from each other’s...
title: Xi tells Modi China and India bear ‘significant responsibilities’ as Global South powers

author: Dannie Peng
description:
Chinese researchers have modelled a war game scenario suggesting that a complete economic decoupling between the US and China could, unexpectedly, yield dividends for most other nations.
Using a quantitative trade model – a data-based economic framework that estimates how changes in trade affect economies – two researchers based in southern China’s Guangdong province found that if the world’s two largest economies were to sever trade relations entirely, a number of other countries, including...
title: US-China decoupling could benefit other countries, China trade war game suggests

author: SCMP Reporter
description:
Chinese President Xi Jinping on Saturday urged Brics members to bring cooperation to “new heights” in areas such as artificial intelligence.
Speaking at the Brics summit in New Delhi, he proposed an initiative on “AI-empowered new industrialisation” designed to deepen collaboration on industrial and supply chains.
He also urged members to play a “due role” in bringing peace to the Middle East, adding that the group of emerging economies opposed bloc confrontation and the “infringement upon the...
title: Brics summit: Chinese leader Xi calls for cooperation on AI-powered industrial plan

author: Phoebe Zhang
description:
Beijing has urged the United States to “immediately stop all espionage activities” targeting Chinese companies, warning that it had “firm resolve and abundant means” to retaliate after a senior CIA official defended spying on China’s artificial intelligence (AI) and chip sectors.
The call from China’s Ministry of Commerce comes just two weeks ahead of President Xi Jinping’s visit to Washington, where AI and advanced technologies – the new battleground in the US-China rivalry – are expected to be...
title: China urges US to ‘stop all spying’ or face retaliation, slams ‘gangster logic’

author: Jevans Nyabiage
description:
A young Malagasy woman was stopped at Madagascar’s Ivato International Airport last month as she prepared to travel to China for a proposed marriage, according to local media reports citing police. She had reportedly been promised 10 million ariary (US$2,300) once she arrived and married a Chinese man.
The case led police to investigate a suspected network involved in arranging similar marriages. Four people were detained, and police reportedly recovered false stamps, documents and 10 Malagasy...
title: Chinese men warned over bridal scams as marriage squeeze drives search for wives in Africa

author: Phoebe Zhang
description:
“Separatists” and the United States are putting Taiwan in greater danger, state broadcaster CCTV warned on Friday after Washington’s de facto ambassador said the island could convince a potential adversary that landing forces would be very difficult.
Raymond Greene, the director of the American Institute in Taiwan, said in a keynote address at the 2026 Taipei Security Dialogue on Wednesday that “Taiwan doesn’t need to demonstrate that it can win a war outright”.
He added that Taiwan had unique...
title: US wants Taiwan to ‘serve as cannon fodder’ against mainland China: state media

author: Meredith Chen
description:
Authorities in China are taking content creators, fan groups and online platforms to task as their aggressive pursuit of online traffic upends lives and public services across the country.
State media and local authorities have called on these parties to exercise restraint and stop attention-seeking behaviour from getting out of control.
The warnings followed a wave of public attention that hit a 75-year-old man and his wife in Shaoxing in eastern Zhejiang province this month.
Crowds of...
title: China targets ‘toxic’ traffic as viral sensations upend daily life and public services

author: Dewey Sim,Laura Zhou,Cao Jiaxuan
description:
Leaders from some of the world’s largest emerging economies are gathering in New Delhi this weekend for a summit marking the 20th anniversary of Brics, a fast-expanding group of developing nations.
Chinese President Xi Jinping, along with his Russian and Iranian counterparts Vladimir Putin and Masoud Pezeshkian, are among those meeting in the Indian capital for one of the group’s most closely watched gatherings in years.
Brics can point to some achievements over that time, with analysts...
title: Internal splits threaten to slow Brics’ progress as bloc looks back on 20 years of growth
